releases.notes:
**v1.11.3**

- fixed incompatibility with FalseTweaks experimental threaded rendering (#42)

**v1.11.2**

- added a new crafttweaker iingredient transformer that fills a container with a fluid called `.fillFluid` (#41)
  - the old `.transformFluid` transformer that drains fluids has been renamed to `.drainFluid` to be more clear
  - `.transformFluid` will still work for backwards compatibility
- regeneration campfires will properly reset the timer on the regeneration effect if you already have it, like a beacon (#40)
- the regeneration range of campfires that are signal fires is 50% further than normal
- decreased the maximum range option for regeneration campfires in the config from 100 blocks to 50 blocks
- fixed a bug with oxygen checking introduced in v1.11
- fixed 3D campfire render leaking cullface gl state

**v1.11.1**

- added a config option that changes how you activate Set Respawn Point
- fixed arm not swinging when activating Set Respawn Point
- foxfire/shadow campfires are no longer registered if you don't have Netherlicious
  - added a config option to change this if you'd like
- config options that change the default crafting recipes for campfires no longer require restarting minecraft
- fixed some config options reverting to client values if you changed your config while connected to a server, causing incorrect information to be shown in NEI
- improved support for translations

**languages**

- zh_CN translation created by @song682

**v1.11**

- added foxfire campfires and shadow campfires - craftable if you have Netherlicious. (#31)
  - foxfire only hurts entities that are immune to fire damage. 
  - shadow fires apply blindness and do wither damage instead of fire damage. 
  - these campfires inherit most config options from soul campfires for now.
- extinguishing a campfire no longer drops its items. this was changed in vanilla a while ago.
- fixed NEI handlers for NEI-GTNH. tooltips work and campfires render properly. old NEI still works. (#32)
- GregTech 6 compatibility. (#34)
  - igniting tools can ignite campfires and shovel tools can extinguish campfires.
  - auto recipe discovery finds gregtech 6 foods.
- more special campfire interactions are shown in nei: botania's kindle lens, witchery's brews and mystic branch, thaumcraft's primal arrows, gregtech's tools. also, all the special interaction recipes will now show up if you check the usages of the item in question.
- compatibility with soul soil from other mods. (#30)
- campfires are no longer furnace fuel.
- improved waila tooltips.
- fixed some recipe sorting and display issues.
- and more.

**mixin changes**

- removed the "-NM" version.
- now mixins are always in the jar. there's just the normal jar which embeds [SpongePowered/Mixin](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin), and the "+nomixin" jar which doesn't and requires a separate mixin mod, such as [UniMixins](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/UniMixins).
- fixed bugs in witchery brew mixins: high level flame brews will properly re-splatter, and extinguish brews won't stop extinguishing at the first campfire.
- each mixin can be toggled individually in the config.
- added more config options for how mod mixins are loaded: you can disable the early mod loading hack or skip checking for mods entirely.

**v1.10.1**

- added some new interactions with witchery (using mixins):
  - the incendio symbol ignites campfires
  - the aguamenti symbol extinguishes campfires
  - the flame brew ignites campfires
  - the extinguish brew extinguishes campfires
- added some new interactions with thaumcraft:
  - fire primal arrows ignite campfires
  - water primal arrows extinguish campfires
- the lexica botania directs you to the github wiki instead of the default ftb wiki when looking at a campfire
- lit campfire block textures are no longer hardcoded to be interpolated and actually check the animation metadata
- campfires now work with optifine dynamic lights

bug fixes
- fixed #27 - campfire smoke is now lit correctly with shaders

**Edit: fixed broken file "campfirebackport-1.7.10-1.10.1.jar". The one on CurseForge was fine, but this one was broken. It's now fixed.**

**v1.10**

- completely changed how campfires render - they are now rendered as blocks instead of as tile entities. (thanks for backporting interpolated icons, et futurum!)
- campfire block textures and campfire smoke textures are now in the same format as modern versions. this means you can more easily use texture packs from modern versions to change how campfires look.
- improved the campfire burning out system: you can now reignite a campfire that is currently burning out to reset its burn out timer. this makes it way less clunky to use, since you no longer have to extinguish and then ignite again to reset the timer.
- added more info to WAILA: you can see if a campfire is a signal fire when sneaking, and you can see if a campfire is burning out with a specific message depending on how long is left.
- signal fire blocks are now shown in NEI alongside recipes and extinguishers/ignitors.
- in NEI, campfire cooking times and burn out timers will be rounded to a human-readable time. for example: 600 ticks will display as 30 seconds, 2000 ticks will display as 1.7 minutes. holding shift will display it the old way with the exact number of ticks.
- added a config option to render campfire items as a 3D block instead of a 2D texture.
- the "getcampfire" subcommand can now be run without arguments to use the current coordinates, and now also provides you a /give command if you want another copy of the campfire again later.

bug fixes
- fixed #22 - if an input for a campfire recipe changes after a recipe is completed and stops being an input, it will pop off the campfire.
- recipes and other config options that use oredict entries now properly update when the oredict entry changes from a crafttweaker script.
- config GUI no longer prevents you from entering resource locations with periods in them.
- items popping off a campfire can no longer go through a block on top of the campfire.
- fixed overlay render being slightly off for campfires burning out as items.

**v1.9.2**

- added a new config option: "default cooking times"
  - lets you set the default cooking time for recipes for either campfire type, instead of it always being 600 ticks
  - it applies to "auto recipe discovery" recipes as well as custom recipes that don't specify a cooking time
  - if the times for the campfires are different and a recipe is set to work for both campfires, the recipe will be split into two separate recipes automatically
  - improved sorting of recipes to help keep these "split recipes" close together when viewing campfire recipes in NEI
  - also, made crafttweaker recipes get sorted in a useful way like non-crafttweaker recipes already did
- campfires now burn out if there's water on top of them
  - added a config option "works underwater" in case you don't want that for some reason
- "colorful campfire smoke" colors are more vibrant
- if the client fails to sync with a server config, disconnects instead of staying and likely crashing
- in NEI, made it easier to tell which campfire a recipe is for at a glance - campfire recipes that work for both types of campfires display as a campfire that's half of each type (instead of cycling between the two types once a second)
  - campfire textures are now formatted differently (logs and fire are separated). this only matters to you if you made a texture pack for previous versions, which you probably didn't.

bug fixes
- fixed multiple issues with the "signal fire blocks" and "auto recipe discovery blacklist" config options
- fixed campfire smoke always rendering on top of certain things like water and nether portals
- fixed an issue where a crafttweaker ingredient might not have the right NBT when viewed in NEI
- fixed thrown potions not extinguishing campfires at the correct positions (again)

**v1.9.1**

- added a new subcommand: "getcampfire". it creates an item copy of a campfire block, including all its NBT
- reversed the order of the burning out tooltip and the inventory tooltip on campfire items

---

bug fixes
- fixed a bug where if a thrown potion landed on an entity instead of a block, campfires at 0,0,0 would be extinguished
- fixed an odd mixin bug when another mixin also affects EntityPotion (#19)
- fixed "auto recipe discovery" recipes not updating when furnace recipes are changed by crafttweaker (#20)
- fixed synced server config options being replaced by client config options if the config is changed via the in-game mod options gui (some core mods, such as EnderCore, enable the in-game mod options gui) while connected to a server

**v1.9**

- changed how recipes work behind the scenes (check out [v1.9 Recipe Changes](https://github.com/connor135246/Campfire-Backport/wiki/v1.9-Recipe-Changes) to know if you need to update your recipes)
  - recipes are more like actual crafting recipes in order to support more crafttweaker things, such as transformers
  - recipes now handle container items automatically
  - added two crafttweaker methods that use transformers
    - a method that lets you check for NBT on an item and use it up (for #17)
    - a method that simplifies working with fluids (config recipes that use fluids were updated to work the same way)
  - removed a default config recipe that no longer functions as intended (will be removed from your config automatically)
- changed how a lot of recipe tooltips look slightly
- updated how NEI will match ingredients to recipes to be smarter  
- added a tooltip if a campfire item has inventory NBT
- updated wiki

---

bug fixes
- #18 - fix smoke not appearing if the config option "Colorful Campfire Smoke" is off (which it is by default)
- fix campfires rendering the first frame of their animation for one more tick and the last frame of their animation for one less tick than they should
- fix campfires not rendering properly if some other renderer turned off GL ALPHA TEST
- fixed a possible witchery mixin failure if multiple .jars have "witchery" in their name
- fixed a bug where campfires that want to be burning out as an item but already have some other NBT will burn out immediately
- fix a couple error messages being swapped
- fix some error messages not displaying the reason for the error properly
- fix wildcard crafttweaker recipes always failing
- fixed a bug where campfire drops could have extra nbt that was only meant to be used internally

**v1.8.4**
- thaumcraft/witchery mixins sometimes didn't work for some people. they should initialize properly now.

---

this is a very minor update. if you didn't have any issues with the thaumcraft/witchery compatibility in v1.8.3, you probably don't need to bother updating.
v1.8.4 only changed stuff to do with mixins. v1.8.4-NM is completely identical to v1.8.3-NM except for the version number.
